entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Above us!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Violet!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Cendrillon!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Her Persona's...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not on my watch!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Please, stay back!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I appreciate it, but allow me.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I chose to stand on my own and fight.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It's time I stop being helpless!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I hung my head low and took your hand...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But I knew all along deep down...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Pretending to be Kasumi was not the right way...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Ngh... Aaagh!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: The weak, insecure Sumire... dies today!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Violet...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You were the one... the only one[n]who stayed true to yourself!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Come, Cendrillon!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: If you don't answer my call now...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: How else can we make our dream come true!?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Such tenacity...

entries.speaker: Cendrillon
entries.en: It seem to fit you better than ever before.

entries.speaker: Cendrillon
entries.en: The glass slippers are the icon of glory...

entries.speaker: Cendrillon
entries.en: Not just for you, but the other girl within you as well...

entries.speaker: Cendrillon
entries.en: I am thou, thou art I...

entries.speaker: Cendrillon
entries.en: Are you prepared for your debut? The ball awaits.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Certainly!
